card.name: Linking words before leukemia terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words (with, to, or, for, untreated) and bullet marks that come right before a leukemia or myelodysplastic term such as AML, ANLL, JMML or MDS in oncology labels.

modes.label: Linking word before leukemia name
modes.description: A preposition such as with, to or for sits just before a leukemia name like acute myeloid leukemia or AML.
